entries.speaker: Jazz Club Manager
entries.en: Hm...? Oh, it's you. You came here[n]with Akechi-kun before.

entries.speaker: Jazz Club Manager
entries.en: My name's [clr 2]Muhen[clr 27]... I'm the manager[n]of this jazz club. I'll welcome any friend[n]of Akechi-kun's here.

entries.speaker: Muhen
entries.en: But just as the sign said outside, I[n]can't serve alcohol to high schoolers.

entries.speaker: Muhen
entries.en: Sorry, but you'll have to make do[n]with non-alcoholic drinks.

entries.speaker: Muhen
entries.en: But hey, the non-alcoholic drinks[n]taste just as good.

entries.speaker: Muhen
entries.en: The cover charge is 3,000 yen.[n]Okay... I'll take that.

entries.speaker: Muhen
entries.en: You can sit down anywhere that's[n]open. That said, try not to be disruptive,[n]all right?

entries.speaker: Muhen
entries.en: I've got a guest here today. Please[n]enjoy the special music and unique[n]soft cocktails.
